description:
Adds companies to a watchlist or removes them, by domain.

Companies added are scanned straight away unless you pass scan:false. Scans run in
the background at a pace the system can take, so this returns at once: follow
progress with get_watchlist. A company already in the list is left alone and costs
nothing, so repeating a call is safe.

If the scan cannot be paid for, nothing is added. Removing a company stops any scan
of it still waiting and returns those credits.

Cost: 62 credits per company scanned with the default modules, changing with the modules you choose. Adding with scan:false and removing are free. Nothing is charged for a company read in the last 20 hours, and credits come back for any company that could not be read.

add.description: Domains to add, e.g. ["stripe.com"]. Up to 200 per call. URLs are accepted and normalised.

deliver_webhook.description: Also notify this key's webhook URL when the scan finishes. Default false.

modules.description: What to read, from: signals, funding, news, social (X posts), team, technology, business, competitors. Defaults to signals, funding, news and social.

scan.description: Scan the companies added. Default true. With false they are added free and scanned later with scan_watchlist.

watchlist.description: The list, by its id (wl_...) or its exact name.

name: update_watchlist_companies
title: Update Watchlist Companies
